images.title: Two groups of three 4s
images.purpose: Shows (4³)² as two groups of three 4s, six 4s in all, so (4³)² = 4⁶ = 4096.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two rounded boxes side by side, each holding three circles, with one brace under both.
images.exact_structure: Two rounded teal (#0072B2) outlined boxes side by side, each containing exactly three equal plain amber (#E69F00) circles with no text inside; 6 circles in all. Above each box the label 4³. A small key at the left reads each circle = 4. One long reddish purple (#CC79A7) brace under both boxes labelled (4³)² = 4⁶ = 4096, and under it the small label 3 × 2 = 6. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A power of a power multiplies the exponents: (4³)² is six 4s, 4⁶.
images.description: Shows (4³)² as two groups of three 4s, six 4s in all, so (4³)² = 4⁶ = 4096.

image_decisions.why: Counting the circles in two equal groups makes multiplying the exponents obvious.
